title: fix(review): arch-hazards-behavior lane graded code absent from the reviewed tree
description:
## what

a peer review lane returned a given whose every concern grades code absent from the reviewed tree.

- route: `.behavior/v2026_11_16.feat-disputes-reconcile-at-human-gate` (branch `beav/feat-disputes-reconcile-at-human-gate`)
- lane: `arch-hazards-behavior`, stone `5.1.execution.from_vision`, round i002, given r007
- blocker.1 says `asFulcrumFrontmatter.test.ts` imports `assertFulcrumOwedMatches`, and calls it "the pytest". the file imports only `asFulcrumFrontmatter` and `asFulcrumOwed`; no symbol `assertFulcrumOwedMatches` exists in the repo
- blocker.2, blocker.3, nitpick.1, nitpick.2 grade a `NotFoundError` user lookup, a line-total lookup, `parseOrder`, `totalCurrency`, `daysBetween`. a repo-wide search finds none of them

## why it matters

a fabricated given counts 3 blockers against a stone that no fix can clear. the driver can only dispute it, and the lane spends a paid round each time.

## the ask

- find why the brain graded content outside its prompt (a prompt mix-up across concurrent lanes? a response cached from another tree?)
- consider a guard that refuses a given whose cited locations do not exist in the target tree, as a malfunction rather than a verdict
